name: 95130 · San Jose, CA
findings: ZIP 95130 (San Jose) has 38 nonprofit organizations. 16 of them (42%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 12 organizations.
Hobby and sports organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (43% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 95130 (San Jose) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 95130 (San Jose) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 56% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 11 organizations here; 32% of all organizations here have no identified type.
